audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 6 contradicted their own whys in both layers. Row 4 read Lucian though whys[4] ends 'the raw duel stays a skill check'; row 6 read Lucian though whys[6] ends 'the lane is yours'. Separately the header was internally incoherent: diff said FAV, tone was the red hex, diffRating said 8.5/10 and report[14].t said 'Hard matchup' — four fields, three different verdicts, on a lane Maokai wins 57.21% of over 208 games.
audit.why: Maokai's first-item resist/sustain line is what the content layer credits the 57% to, and Lucian has no scaling that out-duels a tank in a side lane. The mirror settled its own header on EVEN 5.5/10 with carry 6/10; this side must agree.
audit.corrected: Row 4 -> Skill 5/10, row 6 -> Maokai 7/10 as matched full+content pairs in one atomic group (mirroring the mirror's 5/10 and 3/10). Header set to EVEN, 5.5/10, carry 6/10, yellow tone, with every prose string that quoted 8.5/10 updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was a 'Relentless Pursuit cooldown window' with no number, and the first-item row credited Heartsteel while the content layer credits a Bami/sustain-plus-resists line for the whole win rate.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — but Lightslinger attacks reduce it, so waiting for a printed cooldown is the wrong instruction; you bait it instead. The Culling is 110/100/90s and is damage, not a lane flip.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the refund caveat written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why and phases[5].why.
sources: enemyKit E cd and text ('Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown')

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things the page never said. (1) Piercing Light's range is 500 — SHORTER than Maokai's 525 Twisted Advance. The page repeatedly claims he 'pokes from outside W range', which is true of Ardent Blaze (900) but false of his main damage ability. (2) Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is refunded by Lightslinger double-shots, so 'engage when it's down' is unreliable advice.
audit.why: Riot's ranges: Q 500, W 900, E 445, R 1400 against Maokai's W at 525. A Lucian who commits Piercing Light on you at its own range is standing inside your engage — that is the concrete trigger the page was missing, and it is the difference between waiting forever and taking the trade.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, winCon, enemyWin and dosFull[0].d.

notes:
The header on this page was the worst incoherence in my slice: diff FAV, tone red, diffRating 8.5/10 and 'Hard matchup' all on the same matchup, which Maokai wins 57.21% of over 208 games. I settled all of it on EVEN 5.5/10 / carry 6/10 to agree with the mirror, which made the same call at Medium confidence from the other side. If the user prefers FAV on this sample, both pages need moving together — flagged in questionsForUser.

The packet defect 'never names any of Lucian's abilities' is now closed on the full layer: Lightslinger, Piercing Light, Relentless Pursuit and The Culling all appear. Ardent Blaze is still unnamed (referred to as W/'Q/W poke'); no string had band room for it without dropping a load-bearing number.

ERROR I could not fully fix: content wants.foe[1] reads 'Hold E (Culling/dash)' — his E is Relentless Pursuit and The Culling is his R, so that parenthetical merges two abilities. The string is 76 characters so it is editable, but the mirror already touched several content strings on this matchup and I kept my content edits to the chart to avoid a collision. Suggested replacement: 'Hold E (Relentless Pursuit) to dodge your W root every time you step up to engage'.

Champion-level kit-flag defect (seventh time): Maokai's Q carries a 'grounding' flag Riot's description does not support. Not asserted, though it would have been the single most valuable thing on this page if true.
